description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the ProjectDao component in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing CRUD operations, filtering, reporting, and authorization related to Projects within the Time module.

classes.name: ProjectDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ProjectDao functionalities related to project management, filtering, reporting, and access control within OrangeHRM's Time module.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including instantiating ProjectDao and populating test data from YAML fixture file.

methods.name: testAddProject
methods.description: Tests creating and saving a new Project entity, verifying it can be successfully persisted.

methods.name: testGetProjects
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of projects with filtering parameters.

methods.name: testFilterProjectByCustomerOrProjectName
methods.description: Tests filtering projects based on customer or project name.

methods.name: testFilterProjectByExcludeProjectIds
methods.description: Tests filtering projects while excluding specific project IDs.

methods.name: testGetProjectById
methods.description: Tests fetching a project by its ID.

methods.name: testUpdateProject
methods.description: Tests updating existing project details and verifying persistence.

methods.name: testDeleteProjects
methods.description: Tests deletion (logical or physical) of multiple projects.

methods.name: testIsProjectNameTaken
methods.description: Checks whether a project name is already in use, accounting for updating existing projects.

methods.name: testIsProjectAdmin
methods.description: Verifies employee admin rights over projects.

methods.name: testGetProjectIdList
methods.description: Tests retrieving list of project IDs with optional inclusion of deleted projects.

methods.name: testGetProjectIdListForProjectAdmin
methods.description: Tests fetching project IDs accessible to a specific project admin.

methods.name: testGetProjectReportCriteriaListAndTotalHours
methods.description: Verifies project report filtering and total duration calculations.

methods.name: testGetProjectReportCriteriaListCount
methods.description: Tests counting filtered project report criteria entries.

methods.name: testGetAccessibleEmpNumbersForProjectAdmin
methods.description: Checks retrieval of employee numbers accessible to a given project admin.

methods.name: testGetProjectActivityDetailedReportCriteriaListAndTotalHours
methods.description: Tests detailed activity reports for projects, including filtering by activity and date.
